text: Neither is heavier—they're both the same weight (1 kilogram each). I assume this is a trick question testing whether you fall for the common misconception that "steel is heavier than feathers" because steel is denser/more compact, while feathers are voluminous and fluffy. The materials differ in density, but the equal masses mean the equal weights when measured on a scale.
